review_description: Easy process, friendly & well informed staff, they know all about what rebates are available and which products are best suited to you and your needs. Highly recommend contacting Electrify Victoria for all your electrification needs.

Sophie guided us through the system design process and provided us with so much useful information to make sure our system is the right one for us. We decided to do solar and a hot water heat pump with Electrify Victoria and are now nearly ready to switch over our gas cooking and heating with them too.The install was super professional and the guys friendly and courteous and all locals!Sophie then came back and showed us how to make the most of our system with the app.Super impressed and will recommend them to all our friends.
Great information (knowledge and communication) and support. Very easy process so far.
